summary: Zone IDs constraining which vehicles can serve the job; if set for one job, must be set for all.
range: Array of integer zone IDs. Overrides zones[] geometries. Consistency required across jobs.
constraints: If any job sets zones, all jobs must set zones.
businessRules: Only vehicles whose allowed_zones include the job's zone (and don't restrict it) can serve it.

zones defines: An array of integers specifying the IDs of the zone(s) that this job belongs to. The job can be fulfilled by all vehicles which are allowed to complete tasks in the zone(s) assigned to this job. Pl…
Each element in zones must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.allowed_zones, vehicles.restricted_zones. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Vehicle's allowed_zones must include the job/shipment's zones.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
Vehicle and job zones must intersect. Vehicle without zone restrictions can serve any zone.
validationRules: zones set on some jobs but not others -> 400.
testingGuidance: Infeasible: job zone with no eligible vehicle -> unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: job in zone 2 with every vehicle restricting or not allowing zone 2 -> unassigned.
